name: sillok-metrics
title: Sillok Metrics — derived data
description: Article-level counts and metrics for the Veritable Records of the Joseon Dynasty (Taejo–Cheoljong). No article text is included; each article ID links to the NIKH site. Source data: NIKH (KOGL Type 1), AKS; astronomy from JPL DE406 and the Espenak–Meeus canon.

resources.description: solar_date_ganji and date_flag (1.2.4): solar_date_ganji follows the article's ganji where a whole lunar month is one day off the converted date (ganji_month_shift) or where the conversion package refused the day (ganji_only); equals solar_date otherwise (blank for ganji_unresolved). Metrics use solar_date.
